projects.title: Agent Vigilo
projects.summary: Isolated WASM evaluators and durable AI evaluation runs.

evidence.quote: Agent Vigilo provides versioned WASM evaluators, durable evaluation runs, worker/coordinator execution, normalized results, and pass/fail gates that can sit in CI or release workflows.
Wasmtime fuel, memory, timeout, log, and concurrency limits isolate evaluator execution.

projects.title: bazel-paq
projects.summary: Fingerprint build outputs without changing individual build rules.

evidence.quote: `bazel-paq` adds a `.paq` content hash beside each generated directory or file.
No changes to individual build rules are needed.
